rows.commentary: 0.3: Xavier Bartlett drops a full delivery in at 128.7kph, which Ben Duckett tucks neatly towards Head at forward square leg.
0.4: Xavier Bartlett tests the channel at 127.8kph, drawing a straightforward front-foot defense from Ben Duckett towards mid-off.
0.5: Xavier Bartlett serves up another full ball at 127.6kph, met by Ben Duckett who shifts across to softly wrist it toward mid-on.
0.6: Xavier Bartlett fires in a 126kph yorker-length sifter outside off, which Ben Duckett jams away to the right of mid-off to get off the mark with a single.
1.1: Spencer Johnson pitches it up and finds a gentle away-sweeper, inducing an inner-bat defensive prod straight back down the pitch from Ben Duckett.
1.2: Spencer Johnson extracts sharp bounce and away-swing on a good length, leaving Ben Duckett fishing on the crease and comprehensively beaten outside off.
1.3: Spencer Johnson drifts a full, away-swinging delivery towards the fourth stump, prompting Ben Duckett to shuffle across and dead-bat it into the off-side.
1.4: Spencer Johnson digs it in slightly shorter at 136kph, allowing Ben Duckett to camp back and expertly steer it behind square on the off-side for a single.
1.5: Spencer Johnson attacks just fuller than a good length at 136.1kph, forcing Tom Banton onto his front foot to fend it safely into the on-side.
1.6: Spencer Johnson errs too straight at 135.8kph, giving Tom Banton the opening to whip it through square leg with his bottom hand for the game's first boundary.
2.1: Xavier Bartlett targets the legs at 129.7kph, clipped away past a diving Head at square leg as Ben Duckett scurries back for a sharp couple of runs.
2.2: Xavier Bartlett pushes full on leg stump at 129.1kph, clipped firmly by Ben Duckett before Head redeems himself with a sharp diving stop.
2.3: Bartlett offers width at 129.7kph, and Duckett dismantles the length with a blistering cut behind point to collect four.
2.4: Bartlett persists outside off at 128.3kph, prompting Duckett to angle the face and steer it straight to backward point.
2.5: Bartlett attacks full at 128.9kph, inducing a slice off the drive that Edwards brilliantly intercepts with a diving stop.
2.6: Bartlett delivers a 129.4kph full ball, and Duckett steps forward with a straight bat to block it into the pitch.
3.1: Johnson tests the stumps at 136.1kph, meeting a resolute defensive wall from Banton.
12.5: Jack Edwards drops this 127.1kph short ball into the surface, neatly punched by Tom Banton straight to the cover fielder.
12.6: Jack Edwards delivers a 106.7kph slower ball that Tom Banton reads brilliantly, standing tall to heave off the middle past mid-on for four.
13.1: Adam Zampa floats an 83.7kph shortish delivery from over the wicket, worked off the back foot by Joe Root through the midwicket region for a single.
13.2: Adam Zampa tosses up an 86.8kph length ball, and Tom Banton attempts the reverse-sweep only to find the point fielder directly.
13.3: Adam Zampa adds extra loop to this delivery, allowing Tom Banton to stride forward and dead-bat it toward cover.
13.4: Adam Zampa tosses it up, Banton flips his stance entirely to sweep it hard through the cover cordon for a single.
13.5: Adam Zampa drifts an 88.8kph delivery straight down leg without turn, tucked neatly by Joe Root toward backward square leg.
13.6: Adam Zampa overpitches an 88.2kph ball, driven crisply by Tom Banton before Marsh flies to his left for a sharp stop.
14.1: Riley Meredith targets the off-stump channel as Root steps forward to dead-bat the delivery harmlessly into the off side.
14.2: Riley Meredith fires one in at 142.9kph angling towards the right-hander, with Root getting right behind the line to push it toward mid-on.
14.3: Riley Meredith cranks it up to 145.1kph with a startling short delivery that forces a hurried top-edge from Root safely into the vacant midwicket expanse.
14.4: Riley Meredith digs it in at 143.1kph, allowing Banton to rise on his toes and loft a crisp punch through the gap between mid-off and cover for three runs.
14.5: Meredith hurls down searing pace at 142.6kph as Root sits back, utilizing an educated under-edge past a square third man to race away for four.
14.6: Meredith tests Root with a 144.2kph bouncer outside off, forcing a checked pull shot straight into the hands of midwicket.
15.1: Zampa serves up an overpitched delivery outside off, allowing Banton to lean across and unleash a powerful drive through the covers for four.
15.2: Zampa fires an 82.3kph delivery drifting down the leg side past the batter.
27.4: Cooper Connolly offers width on the crease, prompting Harry Brook to slash hard off the back foot straight to backward point.
27.5: Cooper Connolly fires it in very full, jammed straight back down the pitch into the bowler's hands by Harry Brook.
27.6: Cooper Connolly tosses down an 83.4kph length ball, comfortably nudged right back to the bowler off the back foot by Harry Brook.
28.1: Riley Meredith drops it short of a length outside off, and Tom Banton stands tall to muscle a fierce pull through midwicket for four.
28.2: Riley Meredith bangs it in at 140.7kph, slanting into Tom Banton who turns it away to square leg with one hand momentarily slipping from the handle.
28.3: Riley Meredith charges in at 145.3kph to greet the England captain with a sharp short ball that Harry Brook clinically pulls away toward deep midwicket.
28.4: Riley Meredith persists on an off-stump line at 140.7kph, allowing Harry Brook to open the face and steer it past the diving backward point fielder.
28.5: Riley Meredith strays with a 138.8kph low full toss down leg, letting Tom Banton easily help it on its way to the fine leg boundary.
28.6: Riley Meredith digs it in short at 143.3kph, and Tom Banton viciously pulls it off the front foot to beat the deep midwicket fielder into the fence.
29.1: Adam Zampa fires through a flat 83.4kph length delivery, and Harry Brook drops back to punch it toward the cover region.
29.2: Adam Zampa extracts 85.9kph of pace, drawing a cut straight from Harry Brook into the hands of backward point.
29.3: Adam Zampa tests the length at 88.4kph, inviting Harry Brook to stay back, open the face, and force the ball through point.
29.4: Adam Zampa floats one in slightly short at 91.4kph, and Tom Banton rocks back to drive it down to long-off.
29.5: Adam Zampa spins an 89.3kph delivery that Harry Brook cuts directly into the welcoming grasp of backward point.
29.6: Adam Zampa delivers a skiddy 92.1kph slider that catches a miscue as Harry Brook tries to heave it toward long-on.
30.1: Riley Meredith crashes through the defense at 142kph, shattering the stumps to dismiss Harry Brook.
39.1: Cooper Connolly drifts one away outside the off stump, prompting Will Jacks to nudge it softly toward mid-off for a single.
39.2: Cooper Connolly tosses it full to Jordan Cox, who drills the delivery straight out toward long-off to rotate the strike.
39.3: Cooper Connolly appeals eagerly as Will Jacks misses a sweep and wears it on the pad, but the impact is sliding down the leg side and they decline the review.
39.4: Cooper Connolly fires in a shortish delivery that grips and turns away, leaving Jordan Cox slashing through thin air.
39.5: Cooper Connolly drops it short, allowing Jordan Cox to swivel and pull powerfully to deep mid-wicket to scamper back for a comfortable brace.
39.6: Cooper Connolly serves a full one outside off, which Jordan Cox cuts crisply away to the deep cover fielder for a quick run.
40.1: Spencer Johnson hits a solid length on the stumps, and Jordan Cox stays rooted in his crease to solidly defend.
40.2: Spencer Johnson induces a bottom edge as Jordan Cox backs away to slash hard, the ball trickling past the stumps and evading a diving Inglis to claim two.
40.3: Spencer Johnson drops it short and wide outside off, and Jordan Cox reaches out to flat-bat it fiercely through the covers to the boundary.
40.4: Spencer Johnson delivers a length ball that Jordan Cox cleverly scoops away over his shoulder, sending it skimming nearly all the way to the fine leg fence.
40.5: Spencer Johnson spears in a yorker-length delivery, which Jordan Cox squeezes away through backward square leg to pick up another couple of runs.
40.6: Spencer Johnson slips in a slower delivery outside leg as Jordan Cox clears his front leg to punch it away toward cover-point.
41.1: Adam Zampa fires it flat into the mid-wicket pocket where Jordan Cox turns it away for a single as Josh Inglis barks from behind the stumps.
41.2: Adam Zampa offers a shortish length that Will Jacks nudges square of the wicket to rotate the strike.
41.3: Adam Zampa gets a fright as Jordan Cox mistimes his slap just past the bowler's outstretched left hand for a single.
41.4: Adam Zampa drops short and Will Jacks ruthlessly pulls it all the way over the backward square leg fence for a maximum.
41.5: Adam Zampa pushes a full delivery through that Will Jacks drills hard out toward wide long-off for one run.
41.6: Adam Zampa finishes the over with a delivery that Jordan Cox drives firmly straight back down the pitch to the bowler.
47.5: Jack Edwards drops it full on the stumps, and Will Jacks simply flicks it away to mid-wicket for a single.
47.6: Jack Edwards feeds a slower ball that Sam Curran eagerly waits for, delaying his bat swing to launch a majestic six high over mid-wicket.
48.1: Spencer Johnson attacks from round the wicket hunting the yorker, leaving Will Jacks to desperately jam his bat down and dig it out.
48.2: Spencer Johnson fires it very full on the stumps, and Jacks swings hard to toe-end a single out towards long-on.
48.3: Spencer Johnson digs out a yorker outside off, catching Curran with a thick inside edge that scuttles down to fine leg for a scampered couple.
48.4: Spencer Johnson offers a full toss that Curran mistimes into the air, dropping safely into open space at mid-wicket to yield two runs.
48.5: Spencer Johnson delivers a low full toss, clipped cleanly by Curran through backward square leg to comfortably hustle back for a second.
48.6: Spencer Johnson ends his spell with a short slower ball that Curran skews off the base of the bat straight to Cooper Connolly at long-on.
49.1: Jack Edwards serves it up, and Will Jacks drills it hard into the turf towards deep extra cover for a single.
49.2: Jack Edwards slips in a short slower delivery outside off, beating Gus Atkinson all ends up as he wildly misses the pull.
49.3: Jack Edwards pitches full, allowing Atkinson to clear his front leg and dispatch a mammoth blow over deep mid-wicket.
49.4: Jack Edwards misses his yorker completely, and Atkinson gratefully lofts it over long-off to push England past the 350 mark.
49.5: Jack Edwards drops it short with a change of pace, and Gus Atkinson drags his pull toward mid-wicket to scurry through for a hurried single.
49.6: Jack Edwards pushes another slower short ball into the surface, and Will Jacks stands tall to flat-bat it cleanly over the head of mid-off for a boundary.
6.4: Gus Atkinson bangs it in short, and Matt Renshaw neatly clips it away toward square leg to pick up a comfortable single.
6.5: Gus Atkinson targets the stumps with a delivery that nips back sharply and strikes Josh Inglis high on the front pad, drawing an unsuccessful appeal from the bowler.
6.6: Gus Atkinson finds the vital inside edge off Josh Inglis's back foot, and Jordan Cox snaffles the catch behind the stumps to cap off a brilliant review by England.
7.1: Sonny Baker absorbs a crisp drive down the ground from Matt Renshaw, forcing Archer into a long chase from long-off to save the boundary.
7.2: Sonny Baker hurries Cameron Green with a sharp delivery, and the batter guides it down to third man for a quick single.
7.3: Sonny Baker gets Matt Renshaw to turn the ball aerially into the on-side toward midwicket.
7.4: Sonny Baker delivers a short-pitched ball angling safely across outside the off stump, allowing Matt Renshaw to watch it pass.
7.5: Sonny Baker attacks the leg stump with a short delivery, clipped smoothly by Matt Renshaw into the mid-wicket region.
7.6: Sonny Baker pitches outside off, and Matt Renshaw plays securely off the back foot into the off-side.
8.1: Gus Atkinson drops it full just outside the off stump, meeting a firm front-foot defense from Cameron Green.
8.2: Gus Atkinson challenges the off stump with a short-of-length delivery, solidly blocked by Cameron Green off the back foot.
8.3: Gus Atkinson delivers on a length targeting the off stump, and Cameron Green pushes it solidly down to mid-on.
8.4: Gus Atkinson delivers a full ball outside off, elegantly driven by Cameron Green through cover before Banton pulls off a magnificent sliding chase near the boundary.
8.5: Gus Atkinson targets outside off with a short-of-a-length delivery, inducing a frantic inside edge from Matt Renshaw that brushes past the timber toward fine leg.
8.6: Gus Atkinson rattles in a 142kph back-of-a-length ball at the off stump, which Matt Renshaw solidly blocks off the back foot.
9.1: Sonny Baker floats a full delivery outside off, and Cameron Green pushes it wide of mid-off to scamper through for a single.
9.2: Sonny Baker bangs it straight down the pitch, where Matt Renshaw drills his shot as Archer sprints sharply to his left.
18.6: Jofra Archer fires in a 138.5kph shortish delivery, forcing Cameron Green to stand tall with soft hands before Renshaw smartly rescinds the single.
19.1: Sam Curran attacks the stumps at 128.5kph with a fullish length, picked up cleanly by Matt Renshaw straight to mid-on.
19.2: Sam Curran serves up a 126.3kph length ball that Matt Renshaw aggressively heaves past midwicket for two as the fielder saves the boundary with a sharp slide.
19.3: Sam Curran drops a 127.1kph full ball on off, which Matt Renshaw ramps over leg slip before Jordan Cox rescues it just inside the fine leg rope.
19.4: Sam Curran loops a 120kph offering outside off, allowing Cameron Green to open the bat face and steer it directly to backward point.
19.5: Sam Curran bangs in a 129.3kph delivery outside off, neatly cut away by Cameron Green toward sweeper cover for a single.
19.6: Sam Curran drops the legendary 72.6kph moon ball, giving Matt Renshaw all the time in the world to scoop it down to fine leg for a run.
20.1: Jofra Archer comes round the wicket at 138.9kph, pitching full and inducing a straightforward defensive push to cover from Matt Renshaw.
20.2: Jofra Archer cranks it up to 142.2kph with a full length, met firmly by Matt Renshaw who dabs it into the off-side.
20.3: Jofra Archer targets the body with a 142.1kph short delivery, forcing a hopping Matt Renshaw to work it securely toward forward square leg.
20.4: Jofra Archer bangs in a 142.8kph short ball, handled expertly by Matt Renshaw as he drops it into the leg-side with a booming call of refusal.
20.5: Jofra Archer hits a 139.9kph good length, tapped firmly into the off-side by Matt Renshaw with no run available.
20.6: Jofra Archer hurls down a blistering 142.6kph bouncer outside off, forcing Matt Renshaw to sway away and seal a clinical maiden over.
21.1: Will Jacks drifts one in from over the wicket, seeing Cameron Green punch it firmly leftward before Jacks instinctively cuts it off with his left hand.
21.2: Cameron Green dances down prematurely, is completely foxed in the flight, and breathes a sigh of relief as an inside edge races down to fine leg for two.
21.3: Will Jacks switches to round the wicket, tossing up a fullish delivery that Cameron Green dead-bats toward the cover region.
21.4: Cameron Green drives a tight length ball firmly past the bowler, only for it to crash directly into the non-striker's pad.
21.5: Will Jacks comes back over the wicket with a slower 82.3kph delivery that Cameron Green punches straight back at the bowler.
21.6: Will Jacks bowls a wide to Cameron Green.
32.5: Sonny Baker tests Cameron Green with a crisp cover drive as Brook launches a frantic chase to claw the ball back from the boundary edge.
32.6: Sonny Baker watches Jack Edwards mishit a lofted chip that sails harmlessly into the vacant spaces of deep mid-wicket.
33.1: Liam Dawson drops it full to Cameron Green, who firmly blocks the delivery into the covers.
33.2: Liam Dawson dives sharp and low to his right to smother a driven return right past his follow-through.
33.3: Liam Dawson fires it full onto the leg stump, allowing Cameron Green to push it toward cover-point for a single.
33.4: Liam Dawson targets the leg stump as Jack Edwards neatly clips it away toward mid-wicket.
33.5: Liam Dawson slides through a quicker delivery that Cameron Green defends sharply before racing across for a swift single.
33.6: Liam Dawson slides a flatter ball into the leg stump, catching Jack Edwards' inside edge as it trickles onto the on-side.
34.1: Sam Curran bamboozles Jack Edwards with an exquisite 81.5kph slower ball yorker that crashes straight into the base of middle stump.
34.2: Sam Curran strikes immediately as Xavier Bartlett flicks a nothing delivery straight into the waiting hands of Tom Banton at mid-wicket.
34.3: Sam Curran targets the outside off channel with a full delivery that is solidly defended off the front foot.
34.4: Sam Curran steams in to deliver a tight full ball that is comfortably blocked out.
34.5: Sam Curran digs it in short, and Adam Zampa swivels, pulling it fiercely behind square to pierce the gap and race away to the rope.
34.6: Sam Curran adjusts his length, and Adam Zampa gets right behind the line to block it solidly into the pitch.
42.2: Archer digs it in short at 133.4kph as Meredith clears his leg, hunting an upper-cut to third man, but air whistles harmlessly past the bat.
42.3: Archer delivers a 132.2kph full ball to Riley Meredith, who creates room to thread a single through point.
42.4: Jofra Archer charges in round the wicket at 135.4kph, offering width to Spencer Johnson who squeezes it away to deep cover for a run.
42.5: Archer bangs in a 135.6kph back-of-a-length delivery, punched cleanly through point by a backing-away Riley Meredith for a single.
42.6: Jofra Archer fires a 135.1kph yorker-length missile that Spencer Johnson expertly jams straight toward mid-off for a dot.
43.1: Sonny Baker streams in wide of the crease at 137.2kph, angling a full delivery into Riley Meredith who backs away to push it toward mid-off.
43.2: Baker targets wide of off stump at 136.8kph as Riley Meredith stays leg-side and slashes wildly into empty space.
43.3: Sonny Baker spears a 134.8kph full delivery toward middle, which Riley Meredith manages to squeeze down towards mid-on.
43.4: Baker takes the pace right off to 114.7kph, catching the under-edge of Riley Meredith's bat as he backs away to cut towards backward point.
43.5: Sonny Baker rolls his fingers over another slower ball at 116.3kph, lofted aerially past mid-off by Riley Meredith for a couple of runs.
43.6: Baker floats up a 113.9kph cutter that beats Riley Meredith's intended cut and whisks just over the top of off stump.
44.1: Archer attacks with a 139.2kph short delivery, Johnson averts his gaze during an awkward pull that trickles off the splice toward the off-side.

44.2: Jofra Archer digs it in short, Spencer Johnson backs away to launch it over the vacant slips, and Sonny Baker charges in from third man to launch into a forward dive only to watch the chance spill through his fingers.
44.3: Jofra Archer fires in a searing 139.2kph full delivery that sneaks past Spencer Johnson's wild heave across the line to shatter the timber, sealing a comprehensive 135-run victory for England.

preview.text: Australia and England meet in a one-day match at Adelaide Oval, where their 85 recorded one-day meetings show 52 wins for Australia and 32 for England. Australia won the toss and chose to bowl first in a fixture where the usual first-innings score across 16 recorded one-day matches at the venue is 243. The forecast for the next 8 hours indicates up to a 51 per cent chance of rain and about 17 degrees.

summary.text: England won by 135 runs. ENG made 355-6, Tom Banton top-scoring with 121 off 99 balls; Xavier Bartlett took 3 for 72. AUS made 220-10, Cameron Green top-scoring with 64 off 82 balls; Gus Atkinson took 4 for 28. Sides batting first at Adelaide Oval usually make about 243.
